Last, but by no means least, the youngest members of the Club; boys like Berry, Pymont (a very promising hurdler) and Nelson, having reached the ripe old age of thirteen or thereabouts have apparently made up their minds to "throw away their childish things" and to get down to serious training.

Nelson just got the judges' decision from Archer on the tape with Condon in third place. Certainly the Club is weak in the sprints and these youngsters, given the right encouragement and training, could well put us back on the map.
